Microsoft 365 kent voor jou weinig geheimen en je weet hoe je moderne cloudomgevingen optimaal kunt inzetten. Jouw rol Als Senior ICT Specialist vervul je een sleutelrol binnen onze ICT-afdeling. Je combineert technische expertise met een proactieve en adviserende houding. Je werkt mee aan strategische ontwikkelingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen voor onze organisatie. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het beheren, optimaliseren en verder ontwikkelen van onze Microsoft 365- en cloudomgeving; Het leiden en uitvoeren van ICT-projecten en technische implementaties; Het beheren van netwerken, beveiligingsoplossingen en SaaS-platformen; Het signaleren van verbeterkansen en adviseren over technologische ontwikkelingen; Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van technische documentatie; Het verzorgen van trainingen en kennisoverdracht aan eindgebruikers en collega’s; Het actief bijdragen aan informatiebeveiliging en cybersecurity; Het fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor complexe vraagstukken binnen de organisatie. review_candidates.description: In this role, you'll join the Government Assurance Team's Level 2 Networking team, where you'll work alongside experienced network specialists supporting enterprise and government customers across critical network environments. It's a great opportunity for someone with a solid networking foundation who wants exposure to large-scale enterprise networks, complex troubleshooting, and ongoing learning in a supportive team environment. This role can be based in Canberra, Sydney or Melbourne and operates within a 24/7 shift roster , providing opportunities to develop a broad range of technical and operational skills. Telstra Enterprise's Enterprise Operations Government Assurance Team is responsible for the day-to-day operation of critical customer services, including service delivery, support and network operations. The Government Assurance Team (GAT) Level 2 Networking team provides advanced technical support within a Tier 1 Managed Services Network Operations Centre (NOC). The team is responsible for the operation, support and maintenance of enterprise customer data networks, ensuring services remain available, secure and performing at their best. Please note: This role requires the successful candidate to hold, or be eligible to hold, a Negative Vetting Level 1 (NV1) Security Clearance. What We Offer Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers Purchased annual leave scheme Additional Telstra day off Additional 30% off Telstra products and services Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for) Responsibilities of the role You will provide specialised technical support to diagnose, investigate and resolve network incidents, service requests and operational issues for Telstra's enterprise customers, ensuring services are restored and maintained within agreed service levels. This Includes Troubleshoot and resolve network issues, helping restore services for customers as quickly as possible. Investigate more complex problems across private networks and Telstra-managed services. Deliver network changes and service requests, ensuring work is completed accurately and on time. Work closely with customers, service desks, vendors, and technical teams to keep everyone informed and drive the best outcome. Contribute to improving processes, service quality, and the overall customer experience. About You We're looking for someone who has a passion for networking, enjoys problem-solving, and is keen to continue developing their technical capabilities in a fast-paced operational environment. Some experience in networking, telecommunications, IT operations, managed services, defence, or a similar technical support environment. Knowledge of network operations, troubleshooting, and enterprise networking technologies such as Cisco or Fortinet. Familiarity with configuring and supporting network devices, with an understanding of incident, change, and service management practices (ITIL exposure is a plus). Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse issues and identify practical solutions. A collaborative communicator who works well with customers and technical teams. Relevant certifications or exposure to technologies such as Cisco, Fortinet, wireless, F5, Juniper, or VoIP are welcome but not essential. When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive. Capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta, com autonomia, organização e foco em resolução de problemas. Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar junto a Engenharia, Produto, Infraestrutura e liderança, traduzindo riscos técnicos em decisões e ações práticas. Para transformar esse compromisso em prática, contamos com o Diversifique: nosso comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Contamos com você para fazer a diferença e mudar o jogo, independentemente de sua identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, crença, deficiência ou classe social. Venha construir o futuro com a gente! Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Analyze system architecture, functionality, performance, configurations, dependencies, and technical risks to identify and resolve complex engineering issues. Develop and implement innovative approaches for scaling cloud infrastructure and improving operational reliability. Identify opportunities to improve existing cloud architectures, engineering frameworks, automation tools, operational processes, and technical procedures. Provide solutions to unusually complex cloud systems and infrastructure problems requiring advanced technical analysis and innovative engineering approaches. Perform cloud infrastructure and application performance analysis, troubleshooting, tuning, and optimization. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code and automation capabilities using technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS-native tools, and related frameworks. Support containerization and orchestration of applications to improve deployment efficiency, scalability, and maintainability. Support the design, development, integration, deployment, and sustainment of Cloud One Common Shared Services. Develop and support cloud migration methodologies designed to minimize mission and operational disruption. Support customer onboarding and implementation of consistent pathways for cloud adoption within the Cloud One environment. Evaluate emerging cloud technologies, tools, and automation capabilities and assess their potential impact on technical and program objectives. Perform technical risk, cost, supportability, and effectiveness assessments associated with cloud engineering solutions. Configure and troubleshoot cloud, virtual, and physical infrastructure, operating systems, networking, applications, and supporting services. Develop and maintain engineering documentation, system configurations, procedures, technical analyses, architecture artifacts, and operational documentation. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering team members. Collaborate with government customers, cloud architects, cybersecurity engineers, network engineers, software developers, DevSecOps personnel, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues and achieve program objectives. Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded Identify and forward to your leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area Participate in growth efforts as requested Ensure all contractual deliverables are met/exceeded to the customer's satisfaction Complete personal PDP and attend Staff Meeting and Storytime (with camera on) Within your program, build productive and positive professional relationships with clients Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements Perform other related duties as assigned Key Qualifications Clearance: Active Secret Clearance Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with 12+ years of experience, or a Master's with 10+ years of experience Demonstrated experience supporting AWS cloud environments. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, compute, storage, identity and access management, security, monitoring, and automation. Experience performing systems engineering activities including technical planning, integration, verification and validation, risk analysis, and system effectiveness assessments. Experience diagnosing and resolving complex system functionality, performance, configuration, and integration issues. Demonstrated ability to identify and implement improvements to engineering frameworks, processes, tools, and technologies. DoD 8570 / 8140 IAT Level II certification At least one cloud certification Preferred Additional Qualifications Experience supporting AWS GovCloud or Department of Defense cloud environments. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence. Experience with containerization, microservices, and cloud-native application architectures. Familiarity with DISA STIGs, Risk Management Framework, NIST security controls, and DoD cybersecurity requirements. Experience supporting multi-cloud environments including Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Experience supporting Cloud One, Air Force, Department of Defense, or other federal cloud environments. Experience developing or supporting enterprise shared cloud services. Experience with zero-trust architectures and defense-in-depth security strategies. Aether Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
